# National Endowment for the Humanities

> > The National Endowment for the Humanities (NEH) is the federal agency supporting humanities research, education, preservation, and public programs through grants and national recognition.

NEH advances humanities scholarship through programs like the National Digital Newspaper Program (Chronicling America), Sustaining Cultural Heritage Collections, and Division of Federal/State Partnership. The agency honors outstanding contributors to American culture through the National Humanities Medal, recognizing writers, scholars, historians, and cultural leaders.

## Key Topics

## National Humanities Medal Recipients

- [Ann Patchett](https://www.neh.gov/award/ann-patchett): 2021 National Humanities Medal recipient novelist Ann Patchett profile
- [Joy Harjo](https://www.neh.gov/award/joy-harjo): 2022 National Humanities Medal recipient poet laureate Joy Harjo profile
- [Henry Louis Gates, Jr.](https://www.neh.gov/about/awards/national-humanities-medals/henry-louis-gates-jr): 1998 Medal recipient scholar Henry Louis Gates Jr. African American studies
- [Jacques Barzun](https://www.neh.gov/about/awards/national-humanities-medals/jacques-barzun): 2010 National Humanities Medal recipient cultural historian Jacques Barzun
- [Cynthia Ozick](https://www.neh.gov/about/awards/national-humanities-medals/cynthia-ozick): 2007 National Humanities Medal recipient fiction writer Cynthia Ozick
- [Brian Lamb](https://www.neh.gov/about/awards/national-humanities-medals/brian-lamb): 2002 National Humanities Medal recipient broadcaster Brian Lamb profile
- [Everett L. Fly](https://www.neh.gov/about/awards/national-humanities-medals/everett-l-fly): 2014 Medal recipient landscape architect Everett Fly African American sites
- [Midge Decter](https://www.neh.gov/about/awards/national-humanities-medals/midge-decter): 2003 National Humanities Medal recipient social critic Midge Decter

## Digital Humanities and Newspaper Digitization

- [NEH Releases National Digital Newspaper Program Impact Study](https://www.neh.gov/divisions/preservation/featured-project/neh-releases-national-digital-newspaper-program-impact-study): NDNP impact study on Chronicling America newspaper digitization program
- [Chronicling America Dispatches: Alert the Social Media!](https://www.neh.gov/divisions/preservation/featured-project/chronicling-america-dispatches-alert-the-social-media): Chronicling America social media outreach for Hawaiian digital newspapers
- [Turning the Page on the U.S. Newspaper Program (1982-2011), Part III: Illinois](https://www.neh.gov/divisions/preservation/featured-project/turning-the-page-the-us-newspaper-program-1982-2011-part-iii): Illinois U.S. Newspaper Program preservation project history 1982-2011
- [NEH ODH White Papers (Part VI)](https://www.neh.gov/divisions/odh/grant-news/httpwwwnehgovodhodhupdatetabid108entryid145neh-odh-white-papers-part-viaspx): Digital humanities white papers on grants and international projects
- [Awards for Institutes for Advanced Topics in the Digital Humanities](https://www.neh.gov/divisions/odh/grant-news/awards-institutes-advanced-topics-in-the-digital-humanities): 2009 digital humanities institute grant awards announcement

## Cultural Heritage Preservation

- [A Green Museum: Preserving Collections in Sustainable Ways](https://www.neh.gov/divisions/preservation/featured-project/green-museum-preserving-collections-in-sustainable-ways): Litchfield Historical Society's sustainable preservation practices
- [Tune In Tuesdays: Howard Thurman and Sue Bailey Thurman Collections](https://www.neh.gov/divisions/preservation/featured-project/tune-in-tuesdays-howard-thurman-and-sue-bailey-thurman-collections): Boston University audiovisual preservation of Thurman civil rights archives
